name: Experimental Mixed Media
summary: Photographs, illustration and type collide on an off-white base with hot accents, stepped timing and deliberate roughness; one element stays legible.

identity.visual_language: collision of media with offsets and cuts
identity.composition_philosophy: controlled chaos: one legible anchor, everything else in conflict

palette.contrast_strategy: black on bone; accents as blocks, never as small text

composition.principles: overlap, rotation, scale conflict, photographic crops

motion.grammar: Stepped timing, jump cuts and offset echoes; abruptness is the style but never at the cost of the one legible line.
motion.stillness_policy: Rare; stillness lands as a shock.

audio_direction.sfx: hits, scratches, glitches aligned to cuts

rendering.strategy: HyperFrames layers with stepped timing; photographic inputs from generated or licensed sources; distortions via CSS/SVG filters.
rendering.resource_notes: SVG filter distortions are fine for stills and short moves; heavy displacement over long durations is costly.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Legibility collapses if too many layers compete.
Risks looking random without a repeating pulse.
Distortion filters are expensive over long durations.
example_scenes: A cropped portrait cut into strips that slide apart to reveal a one-word headline.
